general_information.name: UH—SORRY, I’M A BIT MUDDLED WITH THE WORDING. IT’S ETHAN PARK.
general_information.family_doctor_name: UH, THE DOCTOR’S NAME… I KNOW I HAVE ONE, BUT I’M NOT PULLING THE FULL NAME UP STRAIGHT AWAY. IT STARTS WITH DR. AND THEN, HMM, I THINK IT’S LIM? OR MAYBE I’M MIXING IT UP WITH ANOTHER FORM—SORRY.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly when I have to speak up with people, like in meetings or group things… I get this intense fear and then I end up avoiding work socials too. I blush, my hands shake, and I even turned down a promotion because it would have meant presenting.
current_concerns.goals: I want to be able to speak in a meeting without panicking, really. And… I’d like to take the next promotion instead of backing away from it.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and I was a pretty quiet, watchful kid.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I was a good student, but I avoided presentations all through school. It’s kind of been the same pattern for a long time, honestly.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to build a career that doesn’t depend on avoiding people.
